Collect Cross-Validated Performance Metrics for Nuisance Learners

Source: R/tidymodels_verbs.R
collect_metrics.tmle_fit.Rd

Collect Cross-Validated Performance Metrics for Nuisance Learners

Usage

# S3 method for class 'tmle_fit'
collect_metrics(x, nuisance = c("all", "Q", "g", "C"), summarize = TRUE, ...)

Arguments

x

A fitted "tmle_fit" object.

nuisance

Which nuisance factor(s) to return: "all" (default), "Q", "g", or "C".

summarize

Logical; if TRUE (default), averages across folds and reports mean, n, and std_err. If FALSE, returns fold-level metrics.

...

Currently unused.

Value

A tibble::tibble() of yardstick CV metrics.

Examples

df <- sim_causal_cohort(n = 150, seed = 42)
fit <- tmle_spec(y, a, c(age, sex, lab_1, lab_2)) |>
  set_resamples(v_folds = 3L) |>
  fit(df)
collect_metrics(fit)
